player_prompt.intro:
Kei te takaro koe i Mastermind.
Me whai koe i te kupu huna e {code_length} ōna neke, ō reira neke mai i 1 ki {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
I roto i tō whakautu, ka taea e koe tō whakatau ki te tuhituhi i runga i te ahau e whai ake nei: '[2 1 4 5]'.
I muri i tēnei whakatau, ka tukua whakamārama ki a koe i te ahau o pēke mā me pēke ma.
He tohu pēke mā te tohu i te neke tika i te wahi tika, ko te pēke ma he tohu i te neke tika i te wahi hē.
Kei a koe {max_turns} tuari ki te whakatau i te kupu huna.
player_prompt.with_repeats: me te taea o nga whakahoutanga

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore koe i whakautu ki te rārangi tau kua wehehia e ngā mokowā, ā, ka takaia ki roto i nga kōwae tapawhā.
invalid_move.not_integers: Me whai tau tōpū katoa ngā rārangi.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Me whai tika te matapae i ngā tau {code_length}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Me tau ngā nama katoa i waenganui 1 me {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Kāore e whakaaetia ngā tau taarua.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Kua tātai kē koe i te {guess}. Whakamātauria tētahi atu whakaaro, tēnā.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: Kua whiwhi koe i te kupu huna, kua oti i a koe {black_pegs} o {code_length} pēke ki te tika
outcome.turn_limit: Kua tae te rohe huri. I tika tō matapae i {percent} ōrau o ngā tau.
